messages:
maria: Heads-up: preparing RC for embed-service. planning a quick litmus + 10% canary. target cut 10:30 PT. who can own final sign-off?

alex: I can drive the cut. what's the artifact tag?

maria: tag: embed-service@2026-03-23-rc4

deploy-bot: New candidate created: embed-service@2026-03-23-rc4 (id: cand-1720001111). CI green. KV-warm recommended.

tim: QA starting litmus on smoke prompts, ETA ~6m.

qa-bot: Litmus run (cand-1720001111) reported 2/120 failures — reranker regression + one formatting diff. See https://ci.redwood/cand/1720001111

maria: please paste failing examples, want to check prompt vs template diffs.

tim: sample:
```
input: "Summarize invoice"
expected: "Total amount: $1,234.56"
actual: "Amount total: $1,234.56"
```
probable template wording change, low severity.

alex: reranker example failing end-to-end. @sara can you triage?

sara: looking. reranker weights drifted after a default threshold tweak in config. a runtime config override matching prior threshold should resolve.

sara: applying override on candidate rollout to keep behavior stable. no model swap.

ops-bot: Config override applied to cand-1720001111: reranker.threshold -> 0.72 (audit id: cfg-1722).

tim: re-running litmus after override, ~1m.

qa-bot: Litmus pass: 120/120 :white_check_mark:. formatting and rerank checks now OK.

maria: good. start KV warm and 10% canary smoke. want latency under load checked.

alex: kicking KV warm + 10% routing:
```
./deployctl kv-warm --candidate=cand-1720001111 --timeout=15m
./deployctl traffic-split --candidate=cand-1720001111 --pct=10
```

deploy-bot: KV warm initiated for cand-1720001111. traffic split 10%.

infra-monitor: tailing p95/p99 while traffic ramps for 10m.

bri: telemetry nominal so far. p95 +3ms, errors flat, memory fine.

maria: propose pinning artifact in release queue for 2hr promo window; reserve rollback slot. objections?

tim: :thumbsup: pin it. add abort rule: sustained error_rate > 0.5% for 5m triggers rollback.

sheriff: acknowledged. i'll be on call and will trigger rollback if needed. :rotating_light: 

maria: pinned candidate and created promo ticket RB-5510. pin id: pin-1720001111.

deploy-bot: Candidate cand-1720001111 pinned as pin-1720001111. Promo window scheduled 11:00-13:00 PT. Rollback SLA: immediate on sheriff command.

alex: final checklist: artifact pinned, litmus green, kv warm, canary telemetry green, rollback playbook in RB-5510.

maria: ok. final ack to promote at 11:00 PT. reply with "\u2705" to sign off.

sara: \u2705

tim: \u2705

alex: \u2705

bri: \u2705

sheriff: \u2705 — watching the window.

maria: thanks. quiet window rule in effect: no non-emergency DB/schema changes after 10:30.

ops-bot: Reminder: 30m radio silence required for non-emergency changes (10:30-11:30 PT).

-- 11:02 PT --

deploy-bot: Promotion started for cand-1720001111 -> prod. rolling in 5 cohorts.

infra-monitor: Cohort 1 (5%) steady. p95 +4ms.

bri: Cohort 2 (20%) good. error rate nominal.

maria: Cohort 3 (50%) in progress.

infra-monitor: Cohort 3 saw a brief p99 spike at t+2m in region-us-west, resolved ~90s, no user errors.

sheriff: holding until we confirm stability.

maria: holding 5m, alex please investigate backend region.

alex: tailing logs: GC spike on a node pool causing transient latency. scaling ASG by +2 to drain.

deploy-bot: Autoscaling event for region-us-west: +2 nodes. warmup ~90s.

infra-monitor: metrics recovering, p99 back to baseline.

sheriff: ok to continue.

maria: resume rollout.

deploy-bot: Cohort 4 (80%) promoted. Cohort 5 (100%) starting.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete: cand-1720001111 -> prod :shipit:.

maria: promo successful. ryan, can you update release notes and mark RB-5510? call out the config override.

ryan: added summary to RB-5510: "embed-service: RC4 promoted to prod. Applied reranker.threshold override (0.72) to preserve ranking behavior; no upstream model change."

maria: thanks all. closing thread. :tada:
